##### Products Name : LEADEX III Gold ARGB 650W

LEADEX III ARGB series, which are based on LEADEX III platform, features RGB lighting. The Led RGB light possesses 16 light modes such as, Rainbow mode, Breathing mode, Blink mode, and single color mode etc..which can be controlled manually through the button. The RGB PSU could also be controlled through the motherboard from ASUS, Gigabyte or MSI with a 5V RGB header. ♦ The RGB lighting effects can be SYNC through the M/B which supports ARGB function, including ASUS AURA/MSI Mystic Light/Gigabyte Fusion/Asrock Polychrome series.

- Offering flexible options for cable management
